Attached: 1 image

For the CrewAI builders: your crew can answer the phone.
1. POST api.callnode.io/v1/numbers → live US/CA number
2. call.answered webhook kicks off your crew
3. transcript.turn streams every utterance as JSON
4. call.ended returns the summary + recording URL
Voice is just another task in the flow. #AIAgents #VoiceAI
